title: Murder on the Orient Express
writer: Agatha Christie, Paul Dehn, Anthony Shaffer
actors: Albert Finney, Lauren Bacall, Martin Balsam
plot: Returning home from Istanbul on the Orient Express, renowned Belgian detective Hercule Poirot is called upon to solve the murder of an American businessman aboard the train. The suspects are numerous and the clues confusing.
language: English, French, German, Turkish, Italian, Swedish, Hungarian
